title: Chassis load status text is not divided by 10
description: The displayed current amperage is not accurately represented as it is not divided by 10.
steps: Tap on the 'Chassis 1' progress bar to open the detailed view.
actual: The text below 'Chassis 1' displays '0.3 A of 22 A'.
expected: The text below 'Chassis 1' should display the current amperage divided by 10, for example, '0.03 A of 2.2 A' or '3 A of 22 A' depending on the intended unit.
